title: Shadow Copies Deletion Using Operating Systems Utilities
description: Detects deletion of volume shadow copies with native operating-system utilities.
author: Florian Roth, Michael Haag, Teymur Kheirkhabarov, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, oscd.community, Andreas Hunkeler

title: Boot Configuration Tampering Via Bcdedit.EXE
description: Detects bcdedit commands that tamper with boot configuration data, a common pre-ransomware destructive step.
author: E.M. Anhaus, oscd.community

title: Delete Volume Shadow Copies Via WMI With PowerShell
description: Detects PowerShell WMI activity that deletes volume shadow copies.
author: frack113

title: Psexec Execution
description: Detects the interactive acceptance prompt used when PsExec is executed against a host.
author: omkar72

title: Suspicious PsExec Execution
description: Detects PsExec or PAExec execution with a renamed service, reducing noise from legitimate admin use.
logsource: Windows · Security event log, detailed file share audit
author: Samir Bousseaden

title: PsExec Service Installation
description: Detects PsExec service installation and execution events in the System log.
logsource: Windows · System log, Service Control Manager EID 7045
author: Thomas Patzke

title: PSEXEC Remote Execution File Artefact
description: Detects the PSEXEC-*.key artefact written to disk during PsExec remote execution.
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali (Nextron Systems)

title: CMSTP Execution Process Creation
description: Detects execution of the Microsoft Connection Manager Profile Installer, a known code-proxy execution tool.
author: Nik Seetharaman

title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Line
description: Detects PowerShell process starts that use Base64-encoded commands.
author: Florian Roth, Markus Neis, Jonhnathan Ribeiro, Daniil Yugoslavskiy, Anton Kutepov, oscd.community

title: Winlogon Notify Key Logon Persistence
description: Detects writes to Winlogon Notify registry keys used to execute code at logon.
author: frack113

title: Winlogon Helper DLL
description: Detects PowerShell writes to Winlogon helper registry keys that can load attacker-controlled code at logon.
author: Timur Zinniatullin, oscd.community

title: Windows Defender Service Disabled - Registry
description: Detects registry changes that disable the Windows Defender service (WinDefend).
author: Ján Trenčanský, frack113, AlertIQ, Nasreddine Bencherchali

title: Windows Defender Threat Detection Service Disabled
description: Detects when the Windows Defender threat protection service is disabled.
logsource: Windows · System log, Service Control Manager
author: Ján Trenčanský, frack113

title: Security Eventlog Cleared
description: Detects a Windows Security event log being cleared, including EID 1102 and legacy EID 517.
author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

title: Eventlog Cleared
description: Detects a Microsoft-Windows-Eventlog clearing event in the System log (EID 104).
author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)

title: Suspicious Appended Extension
description: Detects file renames to uncommon double extensions, a possible sign of ransomware encryption.
author: frack113

title: Application Termination Attempt via Wmic.EXE
description: Detects attempts to terminate a process using wmic call terminate.
author: Nasreddine Bencherchali

title: Scheduled Task Creation Via Schtasks.EXE
description: Detects scheduled task creation by user accounts through the schtasks utility.
author: Florian Roth

title: PUA - Process Hacker Execution
description: Detects execution of Process Hacker, a tool abused to manipulate processes and security tooling.
author: Florian Roth (Nextron Systems)
